facts.subject: session.timeout.ms
facts.note: Consumer-only (C) property; the table row states default 45000.

facts.subject: heartbeat.interval.ms
facts.note: Described as 'Group session keepalive heartbeat interval.'

facts.subject: max.poll.interval.ms
facts.note: If exceeded the consumer is considered failed and the group rebalances; the same line says the interval is checked two times per second.

facts.subject: coordinator.query.interval.ms
facts.note: How often to query for the current group coordinator; divided by ten while the assigned coordinator is down.

facts.subject: group.protocol
facts.note: Selects the original (classic) or the KIP-848 (consumer) protocol; the line says the default will change to consumer in next releases.

facts.subject: session.timeout.ms
facts.quotedToken: the broker will remove the consumer from the group
facts.note: Property text: if no heartbeats are received by the broker within the session timeout, the broker removes the consumer and triggers a rebalance. Allowed range is set by broker configs group.min.session.timeout.ms and group.max.session.timeout.ms.

facts.subject: session.timeout.ms
facts.note: Client-side check rd_kafka_cgrp_session_timeout_check: the client itself declares the session timed out after session.timeout.ms without a successful response from the group coordinator, then revokes the assignment and rejoins (line 5725); called from rd_kafka_cgrp_serve at line 6264 only in join state STEADY.

facts.subject: max.poll.interval.ms
facts.note: rd_kafka_cgrp_max_poll_interval_check_tmr_cb (line 4973) runs in the client; on exceeding it the client logs, flags MAX_POLL_EXCEEDED and leaves the group (line 5023, except static members) and triggers a rebalance (line 5030).

facts.subject: rd_kafka_cgrp_heartbeat
facts.note: Heartbeat is sent from the cgrp serve path, which line 6229 documents as 'Called from main thread to serve the operational aspects of a cgrp' (rdkafka main thread, not the application poll call); it is rate-limited by group_heartbeat_intvl_ms (line 5809) and skipped once max.poll.interval.ms was exceeded (line 3287).

facts.subject: librdkafka client (MAXPOLL log)
facts.value: Application maximum poll interval (%dms) exceeded by %dms (adjust max.poll.interval.ms for long-running message processing): leaving group
facts.note: Emitted by the client at LOG_WARNING when it removes itself after max.poll.interval.ms; not a group-coordinator log (no broker-side code in these files).

facts.subject: librdkafka client (MAXPOLL consumer error)
facts.note: Enqueued to the application's consumer queue via rd_kafka_consumer_err (line 4992) with message 'Application maximum poll interval (%dms) exceeded by %dms'.

facts.subject: librdkafka client (SESSTMOUT log)
facts.value: Consumer group session timed out (in join-state %s) after %ld ms without a successful response from the group coordinator (broker %d, last error was %s): revoking assignment and rejoining group
facts.note: Emitted by the client at LOG_WARNING (text assembled at lines 5713-5720 and 5725); the %ld stands for PRId64 in the source. Not a group-coordinator log.
